defect_to_test: local extrema are sparse, ambiguously paired, or unstable across nearby windows
targeted_change: resample a preregistered window to an equispaced wavenumber grid and estimate optical frequency from the full window

inputs.common: same data, window, mask variants, angles and units as baseline

expected_evidence: peak stability under allowed resampling and window perturbations
rejection_rules: gain is unstable across raw/masked pair
cannot outperform baseline on preregistered stability criteria
